audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2, 3 and 4-5 were marked 'Skill' and Level 6 was given to Irelia, but every matching why says Garen wins those stages (W tenacity shortens the stun, Q out-damages the window, Demacian Justice executes any low all-in). The packet chart and the already-applied mirror both give Garen every row through Level 6.
audit.why: Courage gives tenacity plus a shield (22/19.5/17/14.5/12s), Decisive Strike silences on an 8s flat cooldown, and Perseverance regenerates percent health out of combat — Irelia has no stage advantage until her items land.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-4 flipped to Garen in both layers with matching ratings; rows 5 and 6 stay Irelia to match the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 phase why sold Vanguard's Edge as the kill spike, which is the opposite of what happens: level 6 is Garen's spike because of Demacian Justice.
audit.why: Demacian Justice is an execute (120/100/80s) dealing true damage that scales with missing health, so Irelia's Defiant Dance physical reduction does nothing against it.
audit.corrected: Level-6 phase why rewritten around the execute; whys[4] now says the R ignores armour instead of the vaguer 'finishes you through your W block'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions described Courage only as 'damage reduction on cast' and never mentioned the tenacity that cuts your Flawless Duet stun, the shield, or that Decisive Strike is an auto-attack reset. The 'Fight through his W' don't had text about burning your own cooldown.
audit.why: Courage grants a shield and tenacity for a brief moment, then lesser damage reduction; Decisive Strike is flagged autoReset plus silence, so the wind-up animation, not the cast, is the cue to disengage.
audit.corrected: Report block now names the shield, the tenacity effect on your stun, and the Decisive Strike reset tell; the don't now states the shield and tenacity eat your stun window; the silence don't now says exactly what goes offline.

edits.before: Vanguard’s Edge walls off his disengage and marks the kill. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Garen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Demacian Justice is a flat plus missing-HP execute — after his Q+E chunk you, never all-in low; save Vanguard's Edge for the item window.

edits.before: Demacian Justice is a flat-plus-missing-HP execute that finishes you through your W block — all-in low and the R kills you before your DPS matters.
edits.after: Demacian Justice is a flat-plus-missing-HP execute that ignores armour entirely — all-in low and the R kills you before your DPS matters.

edits.before: Your first-item reset uptime and shred claw back into it, but his R execute and reliable Q-silence keep this window a genuine coin-flip.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King gives your resets the DPS to grind past Perseverance regen — the first-item window is where you take the lane back.

edits.before: Track Garen's Courage: Damage reduction on cast. Trade once it’s down. When it is down — E-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Courage shields and gives tenacity that cuts your stun; his Decisive Strike auto reset is the wind-up tell.

edits.before: That is Garen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Silenced, you cannot E, Q-reset or W — your whole pattern is offline for it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Its shield and tenacity at rank 5 eat your whole stun window.

notes: The packet lists first item as 'Skill' while the already-applied mirror (garen__irelia) gives Irelia first item; I followed the mirror so mirror-fix has nothing to correct, and rewrote whys[5] to stop calling that row a coin-flip. Also: the packet header lists games 3029 at the brief level but 1490 inside the packet — worth checking which figure the page renders.
